text:
maria: Quick UX review on the model catalog compare view + quick filters. Two a11y items + one copy tweak. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/prototype

jason: Thanks — can you call out the specifics? I remember flagging chip hit targets earlier.

priya: Biggest: screen reader experience for filter chips. VoiceOver reads just 'button' when a chip gets focus. We need descriptive aria-labels (e.g., 'Filter: latency under 50ms') and aria-pressed.

liam: Agree. Also keyboard users don't get an announcement when a filter toggles. We should update to announce state changes (aria-live or sr-only region).

maria: Good point. Mobile discoverability: the prototype supports swipe-to-reveal actions on compare rows but there's no affordance or hint. Users won't know to try it.

jason: What about a subtle drag-handle icon + sr-only text 'Swipe row for actions'? Minimal visual cost.

priya: Prefer sr-only announcement on row focus: when row receives focus say 'row actions available, swipe or press enter'. That avoids clutter.

liam: For the filter chip markup proposal — example:
```html
<button class="filter-chip" role="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Filter: model size under 7B">
  7B
</button>
```
Make sure aria-pressed toggles to true and we update an aria-live region with 'Filter applied: ...'.

maria: Copy tweak: tooltip for 'pin version' reads 'Pin this version' today. Suggest: 'Pin version to compare across views' — more explicit for new users.

jason: Noted. I'll draft the tooltip copy and push to the component lib.

liam: Performance badges: the current green/blue combos fail contrast tests at small sizes. We need at least 4.5:1. Suggest swapping warn to orange (#d9730d) and pass to dark green (#12733b) token values.

priya: Badges also need accessible names. Add title and sr-only text like 'Performance: pass — p95 12ms' so screen readers can surface metric context.

figma-bot: Updated Figma with sr-only layer examples and a small drag-handle symbol at /components/row/handles — see page 'Compare - a11y hints'.

jason: I'll open a small PR: 1) add aria-labels + aria-pressed on chips, 2) sr-only row hint on focus, 3) badge title + color token swap. @maria can you confirm the tooltip copy before I merge?

maria: Confirmed. Also please add an e2e test to tab through the filter chips and assert announcements and pressed states.

jason: Yep — will include tests.

a11y-bot: Created ticket A11Y-412: steps -> 1) add descriptive aria-labels for filter chips; 2) implement aria-pressed + update aria-live region; 3) add sr-only focus hint for swipe/row actions; 4) update badge color tokens for contrast; 5) add e2e keyboard announcement tests.

maria: Great. Assigning to @jason and @liam. Let's review changes in design sync tomorrow 9:00am PT. :thumbsup:

liam: Thanks — on it.

priya: Thanks all — small changes but big impact for keyboard/VO users.
